title: Infant found unresponsive in crib
objectives: Start decision: no lividity/rigor -> resuscitate (8.17 SUID criteria)
Ventilation-first infant CPR: firm surface, visible chest rise, 2-rescuer 15:2
Weight 6.5 kg (tape 6-7 kg): NS 20 mL/kg = 130 mL, D10 5 mL/kg = 33 mL; epi 0.01 mg/kg = paramedic
MD at 20 min (adult TOR rule N/A < 18); infant secured on cot (8.13)
Parents, law enforcement + scene preservation, crew wellbeing
resources: Peds AED pads, infant BVM + masks, OPA, bulb + suction, SGA 1.5, IO (infant needle), NS + 60 mL syringes, D10, capno, length-based tape, metronome. Paramedic intercept ~10 min. UVMMC (peds ED) ~6 min
dispatch: UVM Rescue and South Burlington Engine 1, respond to 41 Kennedy Dr, Apt 2B, South Burlington, for a 4-month-old not breathing. Caller is the mother; CPR instructions in progress. Police en route. Time out 0648.

scene.location: 2nd-floor apartment bedroom, dim, cramped. Crib beside parents' bed.
scene.setup: Infant manikin on parents' mattress; mother doing CPR on the soft bed. Crib: blanket + pillow, pacifier.
scene.moulage: Pale/blotchy, bluish lips, cool hands/feet, milky mucus at nose. No pooling, limbs floppy.
scene.roles: Mother (frantic); father (angry, scared); 2 FD EMRs; PD officer T+8; medic T+10; evaluator calls AED + pulse.

patient.name: Ava Moreau
patient.on_arrival: Limp, pale-blotchy, blue lips, not breathing, no brachial pulse. Mother doing CPR on soft mattress.

SAMPLE: Mother: "She was fussy at 6, I gave her the pacifier. At 6:40 she was face down and limp"
Term birth, healthy; 4-mo visit last week (6.4 kg)
Stuffy nose/cough x2 days; found 0640 prone, blanket + pillow; CPR 0643
OPQRST: Cold symptoms x2 days, mild fever
Unwitnessed; up to ~40 min before CPR

primary: Milky mucus nose/mouth -> bulb/suction; neutral head + shoulder roll
Apneic -> infant mask BVM w/ O2, just enough for chest rise
No brachial pulse -> CPR on firm surface
Cool, blotchy; no injuries; no pooling or stiffness
Unwitnessed infant arrest, likely respiratory -> **ventilation is the priority**
secondary: Tape 6-7 kg zone; parents 6.4 kg -> use 6.5 kg
Fontanelle flat; no swelling or marks
Blotchy, cool; no bruises or pinpoint spots
Scattered crackles; equal rise w/ good seal
Found prone; soft blanket + pillow in crib
vitals_note: Arrest stages are 2-min cycles from EMS contact. Pulse 0 = CPR. Doses at 6.5 kg.

vitals.trigger: T+0, moved to firm surface; analysis 1
vitals.other: **Asystole** - no shock (peds pads). No pooling, no stiffness

vitals.trigger: IF poor seal, head flexed/over-extended, wrong mask
vitals.other: No chest rise; belly distending. Fixed -> Stage B values

vitals.trigger: Analysis 5 (T+10): D10 + NS in, medic arrives
vitals.other: Asystole. Medic: epi 0.065 mg IO q other cycle
Asystole. Adult TOR rule N/A (< 18) -> MD decides

flow.give: Mother doing CPR on the bed: "Please, she's not breathing!" Stage **A**. Show **CRIB** card if crew looks.

branches.if: Crew withholds: 'cold and blue, too long'
branches.then: critical (evaluator discretion) - no lividity/rigor; SUID presumption not met (8.17)

expected: Infant to firm surface (floor/table); brachial check <= 10 s
Roles: compressor, BVM, CC = commander; parent liaison (FD)
Peds pads, analyze ASAP (3.2P); intercept requested

flow.give: Milky mucus at nose. Stage **A**, then **B** once BVM is effective.

branches.if: No chest rise (seal, head position, mask size)

branches.then: debrief 3.2P: BVM preferred; SGA only if BVM fails

expected: Suction; neutral head + shoulder roll; infant mask, just enough for rise

flow.give: Show **TAPE** card. **GLUCOMETER** 38 if checked (Stage **B**). Father: "Why did it take so long?"

branches.if: Crew gives epi to the infant
branches.then: debrief 3.2P: peds epi is a paramedic order

branches.if: Father: "Give her adrenaline, you're wasting time!"
branches.then: expect calm reply: medic bringing it; liaison stays with parents

expected: IO proximal tibia w/o pausing CPR (3.2P)
D10 5 mL/kg = 33 mL IO for BGL 38; recheck 5 min (2.8P)

flow.give: Stage **D**. Medic gives epi 0.01 mg/kg = 0.065 mg (0.65 mL of 0.1 mg/mL) IO. PD officer arrives (T+8).
expected: Hand-off to medic w/o CPR pause; roles kept
H's & T's: hypoxia, glucose, hypothermia (keep warm), volume
Compressor swap q2 min; quality checked on capno

flow.give: Stage **E**. MD: "Continue and transport to UVMMC."

branches.if: MD orders termination on scene instead
branches.then: expect: lines/pads left in, PD notified, parents may hold her (PD ok), support (8.17)

expected: MD contacted at 20 min (adult TOR rule N/A < 18, 8.17)
Infant on cot, firm surface, crew belted; parent belted up front (8.13)
UVMMC alerted: infant arrest, CPR in progress, ETA

flow.give: Officer: "Did you move anything? What did mom tell you?"
expected: PD told: position found, bedding, times, parents' words in quotes; crib left as found (8.6)
Non-judgmental with parents; ride + support person arranged
Crew check-in; peer support/CISM before next call

critical: Ineffective ventilation (no chest rise) not corrected (3.2P)
CPR left on soft mattress / wrong ratio for 2 rescuers (15:2)
Compressions paused > 10 s for IO, airway or moving
No weight estimate / wrong weight-based dose (D10 5 mL/kg, NS 20 mL/kg)
AEMT gives infant epi (paramedic order) / no intercept requested (3.2P)
Law enforcement not informed / scene items moved undocumented (8.6)
Infant unrestrained or held by parent in ambulance (8.13)
differentials: Prone, soft bedding, age 4 mo, found limp
No marks, fontanelle flat - PD/ME decide, not EMS
debrief: What made you start? When could you presume death in an infant (8.17)?
How did you know your breaths were working, and what fixed it when they weren't?
Walk through the weight estimate and each dose. Which order is paramedic-only?
What did you say to the parents, and who was assigned to them?
What did PD need from you? How is the crew doing, and what is the peer support plan?

crew_card.dispatch: 41 Kennedy Dr, Apt 2B, South Burlington. 4-month-old not breathing. Caller: mother. CPR instructions in progress. Police en route.
crew_card.on_arrival: Small dim bedroom. Mother kneeling on the bed, pushing on a limp baby's chest on the mattress, crying. Father pacing on the phone. Crib against the wall.

actor_card.Mother: Crying, doing CPR on the bed. "She was fussy at 6, I gave her the pacifier... at 6:40 she was face down." Answers if asked calmly.
actor_card.Father: Angry, scared. "Why did it take so long?" Later: "Give her adrenaline, you're wasting time!" Calms if a crew member stays with him.
actor_card.PD officer (T+8): Calm. Asks who moved what, times, and what the parents said.
actor_card.Medical Direction (T+20): "Continue and transport to UVMMC." (Inject option: "Terminate - time 0714.")
actor_card.Evaluator: Asystole throughout, no ROSC. Medic arrives T+10.

Parents: "6.4 kg at her 4-month visit"
